title: Searching the wrong pond
literal_meaning: Like losing something in a small tank and searching for it in a pond.
explanation: The search has moved away from the place of the loss. A larger or more noticeable place will not become the right one simply because it attracts attention. As an analogy, the image can question effort directed at the wrong location or cause. It asks the listener to connect the search with what actually happened before continuing. The source defines the small tank and labels the comparison; this explanation extends the spatial mismatch into an everyday use, without claiming a particular lost object or origin story.
meaning_odia: ଜିନିଷଟି ହଜିଛି ଗାଡ଼ିଆରେ, ଖୋଜା ଚାଲିଛି ପୋଖରୀରେ। ଖୋଜିବାର ପରିଶ୍ରମ ଥିଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ ସ୍ଥାନର ମେଳ ନାହିଁ। କେଉଁଠି ଭୁଲ ହେଲା ନ ଦେଖି ଅନ୍ୟଠାରେ ଉତ୍ତର ଖୋଜିବାକୁ ଆମେ ଏହି ତୁଳନାରେ ବୁଝିପାରୁ। ଆଉ ଅଧିକ ଖୋଜିବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଖୋଜାର ଦିଗଟି ଠିକ୍ କି ନାହିଁ, ସେ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ଉଠେ।
english_summary: Effort misses its mark when the search is detached from where the loss occurred.
odia_summary: ଯେଉଁଠି ହଜିଛି ତାହା ଛାଡ଼ି ଅନ୍ୟଠାରେ ଖୋଜିଲେ ପରିଶ୍ରମ ଠିକ୍ ଦିଗରେ ଯାଏନାହିଁ।
usage_example: Original imagined example: A team keeps checking the delivery van for a missing parcel, although its own register says the parcel never left the store. One member quotes the analogy and asks them to begin with the store records.
cultural_context: The historical headword includes caste-ranked speech labels. Those labels are not adopted as facts about present communities. No animal, waterbody practice or actual loss event is reconstructed.
